migration.backfill: Sets workHandedOverAt only for accounts a past apply recorded, from the BuildActivity rows tool='apply_account_handover' summary 'Handed over from <email> (BI-F25A5FC7)' (earliest createdAt). On the live install that is one account (admin@dpf.local, 2026-10-01 10:41:18Z). workHandedOverById stays NULL because the approver was not recorded then. Only NULL markers are written; re-runnable.
migration.rollback: Forward-only and additive. Older code never reads the columns. Clearing a marker (UPDATE User SET workHandedOverAt = NULL) restores the old owner rules for that account.
